title: DH3:Plates
note: Curated figures from the Lampić 2009 PDF. Workbench stamps are four-color; the viewer may show the source. The Tree is the map.

plates.title: The Secret Teachings of All Ages
plates.legend: Knapp's cover: the folio as a physical event.
plates.caption: The 1928 binding was the argument: a plate you could hold. This is the door of the BBS.

plates.title: Coelum Empyreum
plates.legend: Spheres from Luna to the primum mobile.
plates.caption: Hall's solar chapter in one diagram: planets nested, zodiac on the rim, the empyrean as God's habitation.

plates.title: Great Pyramid, looking west
plates.legend: Passages as degrees. The coffer is a gate.
plates.caption: A sermon in stone: ascending passage, gallery, king's chamber, the forced hole of al-Mamun.

plates.title: Isis
plates.legend: The virgin of the world, sistrum in hand.
plates.caption: Widow and womb. Osiris is the light cut up; she gathers the pieces.

plates.title: The zodiacal man
plates.caption: The belt of living signs as anatomy. Pair with the human-body chapter and the Tree.

plates.title: The Bembine Table of Isis
plates.legend: Bronze filing cabinet. A later map.
plates.caption: Mensa Isiaca. Three registers of gods. Hall reads it as a doctrine you can point at. Not the clickable map this round.

plates.title: Planetary seals
plates.caption: The same Chaldean order as HALL's hour. Magic as leftover liturgy.

plates.title: The sephirothic system
plates.caption: Kircher's tree as HALL's filesystem. Not Codex's SVG gadget. Globes open chapters and Guide nodes.

plates.title: Mysterium Magnum
plates.legend: Rose Cross as a public riddle.
plates.caption: Tincture, faith, hope. The Order's emblem as a German broadside.

plates.title: Mundus Elementaris
plates.caption: Months, planets, elements. One of Hall's fifteen diagrams doing the work of a chapter.
